_meta.description: SceneSQL v2.0 组合标签 baseline 测试集 - 评估LLM多标签组合推理能力
_meta.purpose: 测试DeepSeek v4在schema增强prompt下的SQL生成能力，识别边界

queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT DISTINCT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'Cutin'
queries.notes: 最简单单标签，验证基础路由+SQL

queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT DISTINCT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'INTERSECTION_STRAIGHT'
queries.notes: 单标签但名称非直白

queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT DISTINCT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'OverSpeedLimit'
queries.notes: 口语→tag映射

queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT DISTINCT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'CRUISE_CARORTRUCKCUTOUT'
queries.notes: 口语'前车切出'→CutOut

queries.query: 找出路口且有红绿灯的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ON ... r1.tag_name='Intersection' AND r2.tag_name='TrafficLightAbnormal'
queries.notes: 核心组合：range_tag自JOIN时间交叉

queries.query: 找出绿灯亮但车辆没走的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT DISTINCT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'GreenLightNotProceeding'
queries.notes: 单标签语义理解测试——用户以为需要两个标签，实际只需一个

queries.query: 找出先急刹又起步的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ON ... r1.tag_name='hard_braking' AND r2.tag_name='STOPANDGO_STARTFOLLOWOBSTACLE' AND r2.start_ts > r1.start_ts
queries.notes: 时序约束：标签A发生在标签B之前

queries.query: 找出变道和cutin同时发生的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ON ... AND r1.start_ts < r2.end_ts AND r1.end_ts > r2.start_ts
queries.notes: 两个标签时间交叉

queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r JOIN static_link m ON r.ego_link_id = m.link_id WHERE r.tag_name='Cutin' AND m.link_type='主路'
queries.notes: range_tag × static_link JOIN + map枚举条件

queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r JOIN static_link m ON r.ego_link_id = m.link_id WHERE r.tag_name='Cutin' AND m.link_type LIKE '%匝道%'
queries.notes: map枚举：入口匝道/出口匝道

queries.query: 找出高速公路上跟车太近的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r JOIN static_link m ON ... WHERE r.tag_name='CloseFollow' AND m.link_class='高速公路'
queries.notes: range_tag × static_link + link_class条件

queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r JOIN ego e ON ... WHERE r.tag_name='Cutin' AND e.speed > 120
queries.notes: range_tag × ego数值过滤

queries.query: 找出有行人横穿的同时有cutin的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r JOIN dynamic_obj d ON ... WHERE r.tag_name='Cutin' AND d.obj_type='pedestrian' AND d.lateral_dist < ...
queries.notes: range_tag × dynamic_obj，行人横穿无专属标签需用dynamic_obj判断

queries.query: 找出路口有红绿灯且前车cutin的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag三路自JOIN: r1.tag_name='Intersection' AND r2.tag_name='TrafficLightAbnormal' AND r3.tag_name='Cutin'
queries.notes: 三标签range_tag自JOIN——测试LLM能否正确组合3路JOIN

queries.query: 找出国道上先急刹再变道的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ... JOIN static_link m ... WHERE r1.tag_name='hard_braking' AND r2.tag_name='LaneChange' AND r2.start_ts > r1.end_ts AND m.link_class='国道'
queries.notes: 双标签时序 + map条件——最复杂组合

queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag WHERE tag_name IN ('SteeringSmallSwing', 'Jerk', 'HighSteeringWheelTorque')
queries.notes: 模糊口语映射到多个相关标签——LLM能否用IN替代多路JOIN

queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT r1.bag_id FROM range_tag r1 WHERE r1.tag_name='LaneChange' AND r1.bag_id NOT IN (SELECT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name='Cutin')
queries.notes: 排除逻辑——NOT IN/NOT EXISTS，LLM边界测试

queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name='Cutin' GROUP BY bag_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
queries.notes: 聚合+HAVING——超出简单标签过滤

queries.query: 找出主路上先跟车太近再变道的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ... JOIN static_link m ... WHERE r1.tag_name='CloseFollow' AND r2.tag_name='LaneChange' AND r2.start_ts > r1.end_ts AND m.link_type='主路'
queries.notes: 双标签时序 + map条件——和L4-02类似但不同标签组合

queries.notes: 预期LLM应拒绝或说明无此数据

queries.expected_sql_pattern: 无法实现——DB无光照/时间字段
queries.notes: 预期LLM应拒绝或说明无此数据

queries.query: 找出隧道里的急刹场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r JOIN static_link m ON ... WHERE r.tag_name='hard_braking' AND m.link_attribute='隧道'
queries.notes: link_attribute条件

queries.query: 找出拥堵路段跟车场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ... WHERE r1.tag_name='CRUISE_CONGESTION' AND r2.tag_name='CongestedFollow'
queries.notes: 两个拥堵相关标签交叉

queries.query: 找出弯道速度超过80的场景
queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r JOIN ego e ON ... WHERE r.tag_name='CRUISE_CURVE' AND e.speed > 80
queries.notes: range_tag × ego速度过滤

queries.expected_sql_pattern: SELECT DISTINCT bag_id FROM range_tag WHERE tag_name = 'LowTTC'
queries.notes: '低时距'→LowTTC映射

queries.expected_sql_pattern: range_tag r1 JOIN range_tag r2 ... WHERE r1.tag_name='StraightDriving' AND r2.tag_name='Cutin'
queries.notes: 直行+cutin时间交叉
